about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1 (wf10 X7): runner edits that the children laws of an explored run (explore_laws.go) must find, each with a schedule that replays, and edits of the law reader. TestChildrenLawsExplored and TestChildLawsReadEvents run with the tag ergoexplore. scripts/mutants judges only check and lower at this base; a unit that changes these files applies each edit by hand and runs its killers (the X7 runner, recorded in its round request).

mutants.name: x7-late-output
mutants.from: tagged := env.kind == timerSignal || env.kind == workSignal || env.kind == childSignal
mutants.rule: NoLateChildOutput: a child output of an ended entry is dropped, never stepped.

mutants.name: x7-parent-first
mutants.rule: ChildrenStopFirst, ChildInsideEntry: an entry's exit waits for each child's end before it stops the next one and before the next entry opens.

mutants.name: x7-by-kind
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: an entry keeps every child it started, so its exit stops them all.

mutants.name: x7-unshielded-work
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: a Stop reaches an entry's work only after the entry's children ended.

mutants.name: x7-epoch-wraps
mutants.rule: NoLateChildOutput: entries are compared whole; a counter that wraps at 4 steps an output four entries late.

mutants.name: x7-adopt-unseen
mutants.rule: An explored run sees every wait: an entry's exit waits for a child's start in progress through the scheduler, not on kidsMu with the baton held.
mutants.reason: deadline: the run hangs on kidsMu with the baton held, so the test ends by its -timeout

mutants.name: x7-law-drops-child-output
mutants.rule: The reader counts every child output the parent steps; one that drops them never sees NoLateChildOutput break.

mutants.name: x7-law-open-unchecked
mutants.from: l.breaks("ChildInsideEntry", "%s opened entry %d while %s lives", a.name, epoch, k.name)
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: the next entry opens only after the old entry's children ended.

mutants.name: x7-law-work-unchecked
mutants.from:
if k := l.liveKid(en); k != nil {
				l.breaks("ChildInsideEntry", "the work
mutants.to:
if k := l.liveKid(en); false && k != nil {
				l.breaks("ChildInsideEntry", "the work
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: an entry's work is stopped only after the entry's children ended.

mutants.name: x7-law-start-unchecked
mutants.rule: ChildInsideEntry: a child starts only while the entry that starts it is open.

mutants.name: x7-law-sibling-unchecked
mutants.rule: ChildrenStopFirst: the last started child stops first.

mutants.name: x7-law-orphan-unchecked
mutants.from: l.breaks("ChildrenStopFirst", "%s ended while %s lives", a.name, k.name)
mutants.rule: ChildrenStopFirst: no child lives after its parent ended.

mutants.name: x7-law-owner-lost
mutants.rule: A child is found from the task tree: the nearest ancestor that is a work names its entry.
